items.title: Poultry Vaccine License Could Change The Case For Zoetis Stock
items.summary: Zoetis received a U.S. Department of Agriculture license for Poulvac Procerta HVT-ND-ILT, a vector vaccine for chickens that targets Marek’s disease, Newcastle disease and infectious laryngotracheitis, with administration at hatch or in ovo. This three-in-one poultry vaccine extends Zoetis’ livestock portfolio beyond its pet driven mix and adds another tool that can shape how producers manage costly respiratory disease risk in flocks.
